topic: Run tool gating and HUD overlap fix
currentUserGoal: Fix the HUD visual bug where run-tool buttons overlap important text, and stop Root Salve, Dew Pulse, and Sprinkler from being available at the start of the game.
workCompleted: Increased the redesign HUD panel height and moved the run-tool row and Scourge pressure readout lower so tool buttons no longer collide with RT/Earned/GT text.

Added run-tool visibility gates: Dew Pulse stays hidden until enough Run Touches have been earned, Root Salve appears only while wounds exist, and Tiny Sprinkler appears only after the permanent Memory license plus enough RT or an owned run sprinkler.
Kept existing SFX work intact; no changes to the procedural touch audio pass.
Documented the run-tool pacing rule in the core redesign docs and implementation plan.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 30 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
Manual browser visual confirmation is still needed because no reliable visual screenshot automation was used for this slice.
knownIssues: The user has not yet visually confirmed the HUD overlap fix in the browser.
Run-tool visibility now hides buttons until relevant, but the exact unlock timing may need feel tuning after manual testing.
The accumulated redesign branch remains uncommitted and should be committed soon once the current slice is accepted.
nextRecommendedSteps: Ask the user to hard-refresh http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&playtest and verify that the run starts with no tool buttons cluttering the HUD.
Confirm Root Salve appears when wounds open, Dew Pulse appears after enough RT is earned, and Tiny Sprinkler appears only after license plus sufficient RT or owned sprinkler count.
If the taller HUD makes the field feel too cramped, consider compacting title/objective spacing instead of moving the tool row back up.
Commit the accumulated redesign work after user confirmation.
doNotRevert: Keep run-tool buttons paced into the run; do not show Dew Pulse, Root Salve, or Tiny Sprinkler at the first touch/start state.
Keep the SFX pass intact; the user liked the touch sound effects.
Do not reduce HUD height back to 202 without another non-overlapping layout solution.
